text: Farhana Chowdhury is a Security Engineer at AdVerve Technologies, where she specializes in securing ad tech platforms. With two years of experience, she integrates Application Security (OWASP) principles to fortify ad delivery systems against vulnerabilities. Her work includes designing firewall rules and IAM policies to enforce granular access controls, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations. Farhana leverages Linux administration for maintaining secure infrastructure and uses SIEM tools to monitor network activity, swiftly identifying and mitigating threats. She prioritizes encryption protocols and PKI to safeguard sensitive data, while her network security expertise helps defend high-traffic environments from sophisticated attacks. Beyond technical execution, she collaborates with cross-functional teams to embed security into product development cycles. Farhana balances technical rigor with a focus on usability, striving to build systems that innovate without compromising safety. She remains committed to staying ahead of evolving threats, continuously refining AdVerve’s security posture to foster trust in the ad tech space. Her goal is to create resilient, scalable solutions that align with both business objectives and security imperatives.
